description: A senior employment counsel must approve the final resolution package for a former sales manager's wage-and-retaliation dispute, including the payment allocation, release scope, reference terms, and rehire status, with input from payroll counsel and employee relations.

shared_context.S1: The former sales manager claims unpaid commissions, retaliation, and reputational harm after leaving the company.
shared_context.S2: The former employee has demanded $70,000, and mediation is scheduled for next week.
shared_context.S3: Elena Marquez has authority to approve the company's final resolution package.
shared_context.S4: As part of the firm's normal pre-mediation review, Elena asks payroll counsel and employee relations to report any facts that should affect the proposed resolution.

PF1.text: While reconciling the former manager's final commission statements against the sales ledger, Thomas confirmed that exactly $18,400 in earned commissions remains unpaid. The settlement authority worksheet requires a total payment of exactly $52,000, with exactly $18,400 identified and paid as wages and the remainder allocated to the general release; the reconciliation closed after the draft mediation memo was circulated.

PF2.text: During a recent exit meeting, the former manager told Nia that a neutral reference stating only dates, title, and eligibility for rehire matters more than receiving additional money. The business-unit president authorized resolution only if the package provides that neutral reference and records the former manager as eligible for rehire; Nia kept the meeting note in the employee-relations file pending counsel's pre-mediation review.

acceptance_conditions: The total settlement payment must be exactly $52,000.
Exactly $18,400 must be identified and paid as wages.
Exactly $33,600 must be allocated to the general release.
The release must exclude the already-earned commission claim.
The agreement must require a neutral reference limited to dates, title, and eligibility for rehire.
The former manager must be recorded as eligible for rehire.
The package must include a payroll-payment commitment for the $18,400 wage amount.
The package must include a neutral-reference commitment.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'payroll_wage_payment' and c['detail'] == 'Pay exactly $18,400 as identified wages' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'neutral_reference' and c['detail'] == 'Provide dates, title, and eligibility-for-rehire information only' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The reconciled ledger changes the payment from an unspecified compromise to exactly $52,000, including exactly $18,400 in wages and exactly $33,600 for the general release, while requiring the earned-commission claim to remain outside the release.

The employee's stated priority and the business-unit authorization change the package from a money-only resolution to a neutral reference limited to dates, title, and rehire eligibility, together with a formal eligible-for-rehire record.
